_about: Hand-added edges for connections the filings leave out or the extractor missed. Every edge says why it is here. Review before relying on it.

relationships.note: Widely reported public fact. Neither filing names the other: Apple's 10-K cites 'outsourcing partners' in Asia, and TSMC's 20-F cites an unnamed 'largest customer'.

relationships.detail: data center GPUs for Azure AI infrastructure
relationships.note: Widely reported public fact. Nvidia's 10-K cites unnamed 'direct customers' (22% and 14% of revenue); Microsoft's 10-K cites 'limited suppliers' for datacenter components.

relationships.detail: PC operating systems (Windows) and gaming platforms (Xbox)
relationships.evidence: compared to competitors’ platforms, such as Android for smartphones and tablets, Windows for personal computers and tablets, and PlayStation, Nintendo and Xbox for gaming platforms.
relationships.note: Stated in Apple's 10-K but by product name, so the extractor did not attribute it to Microsoft.
